pairs: Locutus quoque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
The Lord also spoke to Moses saying:
Loquere ad Aaron et ad filios ejus,
Speak to Aaron and to his sons,
ut caveant ab his quæ consecrata sunt filiorum Israël,
so that they may be careful of those things which have been consecrated for the sons of Israel,
et non contaminent nomen sanctificatorum mihi,
and so that they may not contaminate the name of the things sanctified to me,
Say to them and to their posterity:
Omnis homo qui accesserit de stirpe vestra ad ea quæ consecrata sunt,
who approaches toward those things which have been consecrated,
et quæ obtulerunt filii Israël Domino,
and which the sons of Israel have brought forward to the Lord,
The man of the offspring of Aaron,
who is a leper or who is suffering a flow of seed,
shall not eat of those things which have been sanctified to me,
non vescetur de his quæ sanctificata sunt mihi,
Whoever will have touched what is unclean because of the dead,
and he whose seed goes out from him,
et ex quo egreditur semen quasi coitus,
and whoever has touched a creeping thing,
et quodlibet immundum cujus tactus est sordidus,
or any kind of unclean thing, the touching of which is filthy,
et non vescetur his quæ sanctificata sunt:
and shall not eat those things which have been sanctified.
sed cum laverit carnem suam aqua,
But when he has washed his flesh with water,
and the sun has set, then,
having been purified, he shall eat from what has been sanctified,
Morticinum et captum a bestia non comedent, nec polluentur in eis. Ego sum Dominus.
Whatever dies on its own, and whatever has been seized by a wild beast, they shall not eat, nor shall they be polluted by these. I am the Lord.
so that they may not fall under sin,
et moriantur in sanctuario, cum polluerint illud.
and die in the Sanctuary, when they will have defiled it.
I am the Lord, who sanctifies them.
Omnis alienigena non comedet de sanctificatis;
No foreigner shall eat from what has been sanctified;
inquilinus sacerdotis et mercenarius non vescentur ex eis.
a guest of the priests and a hired servant shall not eat from them.
But whomever the priest has bought,
et qui vernaculus domus ejus fuerit,
and whoever has been born into his house,
Si filia sacerdotis cuilibet ex populo nupta fuerit,
If the daughter of a priest has been married to any of the people,
she shall not eat from what has been sanctified,
But if she is a widow or divorced, and,
et absque liberis reversa fuerit ad domum patris sui:
being without children, she returns to her father’s house,
she shall be nourished by her father’s foods,
aletur cibis patris sui. Omnis alienigena comedendi ex eis non habet potestatem.
just as she was accustomed to do as a girl. No foreigner shall have the authority to eat from them.
Qui comederit de sanctificatis per ignorantiam,
addet quintam partem cum eo quod comedit,
eats from what has been sanctified shall add a fifth part to that which he ate,
and he shall give it to the priest at the Sanctuary.
And they shall not contaminate what has been sanctified from the sons of Israel,
which they offer to the Lord,
ne forte sustineant iniquitatem delicti sui,
lest perhaps they may suffer the iniquity of their offense,
when they will have eaten what has been sanctified.
I am the Lord, who sanctifies them.
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
Loquere ad Aaron et filios ejus,
and to all the sons of Israel,
and you shall say to them:
et de advenis qui habitant apud vos,
The man from the house of Israel,
or from the newcomers who live with you,
who would bring forward his oblation,
either fulfilling his vows or offering spontaneously,
quidquid illud obtulerit in holocaustum Domini,
whatever he brings forward as a holocaust for the Lord,
in order to be offered through you,
shall offer an immaculate male from the oxen,
and it shall not be acceptable.
Homo qui obtulerit victimam pacificorum Domino,
The man who will have offered a victim of peace offerings to the Lord,
vel vota solvens, vel sponte offerens,
either fulfilling his vows or offering spontaneously,
tam de bobus quam de ovibus,
whether of oxen, or of sheep,
shall offer what is immaculate, so that it may be acceptable.
omnis macula non erit in eo.
There shall be no blemish in it.
or if it has a scar,
or if it is has a boil,
you shall not offer these to the Lord,
nec adolebitis ex eis super altare Domini.
nor shall you burn any of these upon the altar of the Lord.
having an amputated ear or tail,
you are able to offer voluntarily,
votum autem ex eis solvi non potest.
but a vow is not able to be fulfilled by these.
Omne animal, quod vel contritis, vel tusis, vel sectis ablatisque testiculis est, non offeretis Domino, et in terra vestra hoc omnino ne faciatis.
You shall not offer to the Lord any animal which has the testicles bruised, or crushed, or cut and taken away, and you shall not cause any of these things in your land.
De manu alienigenæ non offeretis panes Deo vestro,
From the hand of a foreigner,
you shall not offer bread to your God,
nor anything else that he would choose to give;
for all this has been corrupted and blemished.
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
septem diebus erunt sub ubere matris suæ:
shall be under the udder of their mother for seven days.
But on the eighth day and thereafter,
they are able to be offered to the Lord.
non immolabuntur una die cum fœtibus suis.
they shall not be immolated on the same day with their newborns.
Si immolaveritis hostiam pro gratiarum actione Domino,
If you immolate a victim as an act of thanksgiving to the Lord,
so that he may be pleased,
you shall eat it on the same day;
non remanebit quidquam in mane alterius diei.
none of it shall remain until morning on the next day.
Ne polluatis nomen meum sanctum, ut sanctificer in medio filiorum Israël.
Do not pollute my holy name, so that I may be sanctified in the midst of the sons of Israel.
I am the Lord, who sanctifies you,
and who led you away from the land of Egypt,
so that I may be to you as God.
